WITH type_avgs AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg
  FROM Products
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price
  FROM Products
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, type_avg, type_avg - avg_price AS diff
  FROM type_avgs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg
  WHERE type_avg > avg_price
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS avg_type_avg
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, type_avg, diff, type_avg - avg_type_avg AS excess
  FROM step3
  CROSS JOIN step4
  WHERE type_avg > avg_type_avg
)
SELECT AVG(type_avg), AVG(diff), AVG(excess)
FROM step5
